name: Kaya Yoshiyuki
source:
A suspicious man who can occasionally be found wandering around the school grounds. He’s always muttering nonsense to himself and seems to be looking for someone.
Kaya Akihiro’s older brother.

[Source: [url=https://tarhs.booth.pm/items/1269]preview booklet[/url]]
